test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: By selling an article for ₹20, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 25%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹20

Profit Percentage (P) = 10%

Desired Profit Percentage = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + P/100)

New Selling Price (SPₙₑw) = CP × (1 + Desired Profit Percentage/100)

Increase in Selling Price = SPₙₑw - SP
